name: GlzSelect
semanticRole: Choose one value from a bounded option set while preserving native selection, labeling, validation, and adaptive presentation semantics.

material.rule: Use ordinary solid/raised fields by default. Desktop options open in an anchored popover; mobile options may transform to a sheet. Glaze is limited to genuinely floating/overlay contexts.

input.keyboard: Enter, Space, or platform-appropriate Alt+ArrowDown opens; arrows navigate options; Enter commits; Escape closes without destroying prior selection; typeahead is supported where appropriate.
input.focus: Focus stays on the semantic select/combobox control or moves into the listbox according to the chosen accessible pattern; close restores focus predictably.
input.hover: Hover may strengthen field boundary or option highlight but never exposes an option unavailable to keyboard/touch.
input.press: Press opens the option surface immediately without waiting for material/morph animation.
input.selection: The selected option uses text plus check/selection semantics rather than color alone.

accessibility.role: Native select semantics are preferred where suitable; custom implementations use the appropriate combobox/listbox pattern.
accessibility.name: A persistent label provides the accessible name; placeholder text is not the sole label.
accessibility.state: Expanded/collapsed, disabled, required, invalid, loading where applicable, and selected option are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: The currently selected option is exposed as the control value.
accessibility.keyboard: Complete keyboard opening, navigation, selection, cancellation, and typeahead behavior is required.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains visible on the trigger and active option and returns to the trigger after a transient option surface closes.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Invalid state is programmatically associated with an explanatory message.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Popover/sheet transformation becomes direct or a short fade while focus and selection continuity remain unchanged.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Glaze trigger/options become opaque raised surfaces.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen trigger boundary, active option, selected indicator, and focus ring.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform field/list/selection/focus colors and retain text/check selection cues.
accessibility.largeText: Labels and options wrap/reflow without clipping; mobile sheet may use additional height.

fallbacks.highContrast: Stronger boundaries, active option, selection, and focus.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Platform field/list/selection colors and native semantics where possible.
fallbacks.performance: Remove optional blur/shadow and use an opaque popover/sheet before changing interaction behavior.

content.overflow: Selected values and options may wrap or ellipsize only when the full accessible value remains available; option surfaces scroll rather than escaping the viewport.
content.localization: Option labels, grouping, sorting, placeholder, support text, and value formatting are locale-aware.
content.rtl: Trigger indicator, option alignment, and directional affordances mirror semantically while intrinsic-direction values remain intact.

criteria: Trigger reads as an input rather than an unrelated button.
Selected and focused options remain distinct without relying on color alone.
Desktop popover and mobile sheet feel like one semantic component across form factors.
Long localized values do not collide with the disclosure indicator or validation affordances.
